rule: PRIMARY analysis uses only the 261 frozen G7 PRIMARY_TECHNICAL mono-A/T loci (metadata/g7/g7_locus_analysis_universe.tsv, g7_locus_class==PRIMARY_TECHNICAL); unchanged from G7/G6/G5.
The 39 PROVISIONAL_TECHNICAL loci are a separately labeled sensitivity table only; never merged into the PRIMARY table or its BH q-value family.
The 1,105 PRIMARY_INELIGIBLE loci are excluded from all G8 analysis (not screened, not tested, not reported per-locus).
Use the dominant repeat-length allele only (caller field dominant_bp, equal to dominant_copies for mono-nucleotide loci). No ON/OFF/MIXED functional-state conversion is made anywhere in G8.
PRJNA360417: inferential contrast is NAG (n=5) vs IM (n=6) only. AG (n=1) and DYS (n=1) are reported descriptively only, never entered into a two-group inferential test.

PRJNA678459: inferential contrast is AG (n=5) vs GC (n=5), explicitly labeled STANDALONE_EXPLORATORY_LOWER_PROVENANCE because patient independence is repository-exact (BioSample host_subject_id) but not publication-corroborated. Uses only the already-accepted Issue #9 disease-blind bounded caller output (500,000 fragments/sample); the caller is NOT re-run, extended, retuned, or benchmarked in G8.
PRJNA1103397: GC-only (n=6) descriptive context. No disease contrast is computed (no comparator group exists in this pilot).
Every cross-study comparison (any pair among PRJNA360417 / PRJNA678459 / PRJNA1103397) is forbidden for inference in G8, per the frozen G7 confounding audit (near-total study/country confounding).

Disease-blind per-contrast locus screen, applied to exactly the sample set used in that contrast (11 for PRJNA360417 NAG+IM; 10 for PRJNA678459 AG+GC; 6 for PRJNA1103397 GC-only), using only callability/allele statistics, never disease labels: (a) overall callability fraction across the contrast sample set >= 0.80; (b) at least 2 distinct observed dominant repeat lengths among callable samples; (c) minor-allele count (second most frequent dominant length) >= 2 among callable samples. A locus failing any condition is EXCLUDED from that contrast's inferential table (not imputed, not recoded).

rule: Screening rule (R09) is fixed before any disease result is inspected and is not altered afterward for any reason, including to obtain significance.

Primary cohort-level endpoint: pairwise PV allele-state distance between two samples = (# jointly callable screened-PRIMARY loci with different dominant_bp) / (# jointly callable screened-PRIMARY loci). Undefined (NA) if fewer than 10 jointly callable loci for a pair; such pairs are dropped from that cohort's distance matrix and disclosed.

Group separation test: PERMANOVA (Anderson 2001) pseudo-F and R2 computed directly from the pairwise distance matrix (no ordination/eigendecomposition required); exact p-value from EXHAUSTIVE enumeration of every label allocation consistent with the observed group sizes (C(n, n1) allocations; all enumerated, none sampled, because n is small enough).

Bootstrap 95% CI for R2: stratified case resampling (resample with replacement independently within each group, preserving original group sizes), 2000 replicates, Python random module seed=88022026 (fixed, documented), percentile method (2.5/97.5).
Success is never declared from a permutation p-value alone; pseudo-F, R2, the bootstrap R2 CI, and pairwise callable-locus coverage are all reported together and interpreted jointly.

Secondary locus-level endpoint, computed only for loci passing R09 in that contrast: exhaustive-label permutation test on the mean dominant_bp difference between groups (restricted to samples callable at that locus, preserving each group's callable count); exact p from full enumeration of C(n_callable, n1_callable) allocations.

Report per locus: group n (callable), group medians, mean difference (group2-group1 as defined per contrast), Cliff's delta, bootstrap 95% CI for the mean difference (stratified case resampling within each group, 2000 replicates, seed=88022026), exact permutation p, and BH (Benjamini-Hochberg) q-value within that cohort's PRIMARY table only.
All screened PRIMARY loci for a contrast are reported in the output table regardless of p-value; no post-hoc selection, filtering, or threshold redefinition after seeing results.

PROVISIONAL_TECHNICAL loci passing R09 are run through the identical R15/R16 procedure but written to a separately labeled sensitivity table per contrast; never pooled into the PRIMARY BH q-value family; no primary claim is drawn from this table alone.

Population-structure overlay uses only already-frozen, disease-blind SCREENING_STRUCTURE_ONLY distance results computed in prior gates. For PRJNA678459: the frozen G7-follow-up read-based k-mer/MinHash distance matrix (results/g7_followup/g7f_structure_distance_matrix.tsv), restricted to the 10 relevant samples, overlaid with AG/GC labels after the fact. For PRJNA360417: no existing disease-blind structure result exists in the repository, and the raw reads used for the G4/G5 Phase-1 caller run are no longer present under data/raw (only derived caller output is preserved); recomputing from reads would require RAW_READ_DOWNLOAD, which is not authorized in this gate. This sub-item is therefore NOT_PERFORMED for PRJNA360417 and is disclosed, not fabricated or approximated.

rule: SCREENING_STRUCTURE_ONLY overlay results are descriptive only; no claim of ancestry adjustment or definitive confounding correction is made; no multivariable model is fit given tiny n.

Association is never interpreted as causation. PRJNA678459 remains exploratory/lower-provenance throughout. The PRJNA678459 caller input is bounded to 500,000 fragments/sample and is described as such wherever its results are reported; no claim of full-depth caller validation/hardening is made.
Negative or null results are preserved and reported exactly as obtained; a negative/null result never triggers a change to R09-R18.
